headline: 2026 Limited Edition Solar Hiker Kit
body:
It’s back. The Solar Hiker 2026 Limited Edition is a triple-brand collaboration between VAER, Topo Designs, and Worn & Wound, uniting expertise in watchmaking, outdoor design, and storytelling. 

Built for adventure, it’s a 39mm field-watch-inspired design housed in a 200m-rated dive case and powered by the sun. The dial features bold, raised numerals printed with 15 layers of C3 lume for exceptional legibility day or night. A dual-index ceramic and steel bezel adds practical versatility, allowing users to track a second time zone or elapsed minutes, with subtle solar cues marking sunrise and sunset positions.

Compact, durable, and comfortable, the Solar Hiker includes multiple straps: two colorful hook-and-loop designs by Topo and a two-piece black silicone strap from Vaer. A redesigned Topo case houses everything and acts as an EDC pouch for maximum versatility. Available in navy or black/steel.

headline: Classic Teardrop Backpack
body: An iconic silhouette, reimagined for modern carry. The Classic Teardrop Backpack nods to the heritage packs of the ’70s and ’80s with its curved shape, leather lash tabs, and axe loop, then updates it with durable recycled nylon, smart organization, and an internal 14" laptop sleeve. Dual main compartment and a side-entry access make it practical for everyday use, while details like an internal bottle holder and front zip pocket keep it ready for work, school, or trail.

headline: Mountain Rugby Shirt
body: Classic rugby styling with a premium feel. This shirt combines vintage-inspired sport design with a durable cotton build that holds its shape and only gets better with wear. Reinforced seams and heavyweight fabric mean it’s built to last. A standout for cool-weather layering or casual days when you want a little more weight up top.

headline: Global Waffle Henley - Women's
body: The long sleeve waffle shirt has been a layering essential for generations, and there's a reason it never goes out of style—that perfectly textured fabric feels as good as it looks. Our fitted henley version delivers the ideal weight for layering under jackets or wearing solo. Built to become the piece you reach for again and again, this versatile baselayer bridges comfort and style.

headline: Global Pro Travel Roller Bag
body: The Global Pro Series: our elevated evolution of adventure travel. Move seamlessly betweek work, travel, and the wild. The Global Pro Roller offers a solid carry solution for the long weekend or an extended European stay. Ultra premium materials leading with our weatherproof dual ripstop exterior, high performance hyper-elastic wheels, custom hardware, and thoughtful, utilitarian details that are undeniably Topo.

headline: Mountain Waist Pack
body: Waist pack, fanny pack, hip bag, bum bag. Wear it over the shoulder, around the waist, however you want. The Mountain Waist Pack is our take on the classic agile everyday carry bag.

headline: Carabiner - 3 Pack
body: The versatile carabiner clip. Attach your hat to your pack, your water bottle to your tote, or thread a bandana through it clipped to your waist. We've just scratched the surface on the ultimate utilitarian accessory. And if you're upgrading your keychain, our custom design features a StayPut crossbar, so your keys stay put, and everything else stays accessible.

headline: Mountain Duffel 40L
body: The 40L duffle features removable backpack straps and padded nylon grab handles. With a water-resistant lining, front zip pocket, and interior mesh pockets. Includes top valuables pocket and key clip.

headline: Pompom Beanie
body: Stay warm in style with the Pom Beanie. Featuring double-layer construction for added insulation, it's the perfect accessory for chilly mountain days or casual town outings.

headline: Topo Designs x Pine Printshop Nalgene Water Bottle - Masu
body: The Masu graphic, drawn by Pine Printshop owner Garrett Danielson from mid-century advertising and folk art references, lands on a custom 32 oz. Wide Mouth Nalgene®. The bottle is high impact-resistant, suitable for warm and cold beverages, dishwasher safe and BPA-free.

headline: Global Wool Sweater - Quarter Snap - Women's
body: The Global Wool Sweater, now with a quarter-snap front and higher collar for added coverage. Same soft, machine-washable wool. Same double-knit warmth. Just as comfortable layered up or worn on its own, from cool mornings on the trail to casual days in town.

headline: Cycle Club Tee - Men's
body: Get ready to ride with the Topo Designs Cycling Club: Rolling one way or another since 2016. Relaxed-fit, made from soft 100% organic cotton jersey, Featuring a ribbed collar and subtle logo sleeve patch.

headline: Rover Pack Mini Messenger
body: On-the-go with timeless styling and a durable build, the Rover Pack Mini Messenger is designed for versatility whether on the bike commute, quick errand, or as an agile carry-on. This recycled nylon EDC piece holds up in any environment and stands out in all of them.

headline: Mountain Utility Tote
body: The Mountain Utility Tote is the grab-and go-bag fit for anywhere, anytime. With plenty of space, extra pockets and clips to haul gear for the hike or climb, or simply a quick grocery run.

headline: All Adventure Accessory Bag
body: The All Adventure Accessory Bag carries essentials for travel or outdoor activities. Made from 100% recycled nylon, it blends functionality and sustainability, folding flat for easy organization.

headline: Topo Designs x Pine Printshop Corduroy Trucker - Masu
body: Pine Printshop owner Garrett Danielson’s Masu graphic, first seen on the collab tee, moves to a corduroy trucker. Drawing on mid-century advertising and folk art, the design sits on a soft-structured, 5-panel hat with a medium rise, custom embroidered graphic, paracord brim, and adjustable webbing quick-release back closure.

headline: Global Wool Sweater - Women's
body: This wool crewneck sweater changes everything you thought you knew about wool — soft, comfortable, and machine washable. Features a relaxed, true-to-size fit with double-knit construction that delivers reliable warmth for cooler days. Your new go-to mid-layer for weekend adventures to everyday comfort.

headline: Rover Pack Messenger
body: On-the-go with timeless styling and a durable build, the Rover Pack Messenger is designed for versatility whether on the bike commute or the train to work. This recycled nylon EDC carry holds up in any environment and stands out in all of them.

headline: Burrito Bag
body: The Burrito Bag, made from 100% recycled nylon, is here to make your day easier. Clip it to your hip, attach your favorite sauces to the daisy chain, and get back to living!

headline: Crux Key Clip
body: Keep your keys within easy reach with the Crux Key Clip. This heavy-duty climbing rope fits around your wrist and comes with a custom Topo Designs aluminum carabiner clip and aluminum key ring for added durability.

headline: Bike Bag
body: Our Bike Bag provides a place to stash everything from tools and tubes to an extra layer or essential snacks. Versatile enough to attach to the front bars of most bikes and with other features like daisy chain webbing for attaching bike lights and other gear, the Bike Bag Mountain is a key piece of gear to add to your bike whether you're using it on the daily commute, weekend rides around town, or hitting the trails. Made from recycled materials and weatherproof from start to finish.

headline: Utility Zip Hoodie
body: A heavyweight hoodie with serious warmth and a workwear backbone. Fully lined with our thick Utility Waffle fabric, it’s built to stand in for a jacket on cold days. The metal zip, ribbed cuffs, and classic fit bring durability and structure, making it a go-to for everything from morning dog walks to shop days and weekend chores.

headline: Global Pro Wheelset
body: Whether you're rolling the concourse, or the gravel approach to the cabin, change out the accents of your Global Pro Travel Roller with these high-performance, hyper-elastic, easy to install wheel sets. How to change your wheels:

headline: Topo Designs x Toyota Accessory Bag Medium
body: The Topo Designs x Toyota Trailhunter collection combines performance-driven design, rugged durability and everyday versatility. Made for anywhere on your map. Organize everything from pens and tools to power blocks in the Topo x Toyota Accessory Bag. This durable pouch is built with simplicity and versatility in mind for everyday essentials.

headline: Work Cap
body: Stay warm on the mountain or in town with our Work Cap. Designed from tightly knit acrylic in a double-layer style, this beanie offers the perfect balance of warmth and durability for wherever your adventures take you.

headline: Wool Knit Beanie
body: Made for cold mornings and high-country days, the Wool Knit Beanie brings dependable warmth without the bulk. Its soft merino blend keeps things comfortable wherever you’re headed. A grab-and-go staple for town, trail and everywhere in between.

headline: Waffle Knit Beanie
body: The Waffle Knit Beanie is designed to keep you warm when the weather turns chilly. With its double-layer construction, plush oversized waffle knit, and reversible label for cuffed or uncuffed wear, it's the perfect companion for your outdoor adventures.

headline: Global Briefcase
body: A 3-way carry briefcase backpack bag for work and travel: switch between backpack straps, shoulder carry, or briefcase handles. Fits a laptop, notebooks, and daily essentials, with compartments designed for quick access. The pass-through panel slides over a roller bag handle for easier travel.

headline: Luggage Tag
body: The luggage tag, made from eco-friendly 200D 100% recycled nylon ripstop, features a customizable webbing strap and an easy-to-use TPU window. Travel in style.

headline: Moonlight Crossbody Bag 10L
body: One of our bestselling crossbody bags, now in a bigger option. Featuring an adjustable shoulder strap, front zippered pocket, interior top entry pocket, zippered pocket, and key hook. Certain colorways feature custom jacquard webbing.

headline: Topo Designs x MiiR Camp Cup
body: The Topo x MiiR Camp Cup is a double-wall vacuum-insulated stainless steel mug that keeps drinks hot or cold for hours. It pairs with a press-fit slide lid for added insulation and a splash-proof seal.

headline: Dirt Tee - Women's
body: Simple, classic, comfortable—the Dirt Tee helps keep you grounded in style. Made from organic cotton, this tee feels soft and broken-in right from the start.

headline: Mini Shoulder Bag
body: The Mini Shoulder Bag is the perfect over-the-shoulder bag for daily items and accessories you need while out and about. Remove the shoulder strap to use it as an organization bag, or wrap the strap through the webbing loops on the back and turn it into a fanny pack.

headline: Topo Designs x Pine Printshop Classic Canvas Tote - Catalog
body: Garrett Danielson of Pine Printshop laid out the Catalog graphic like a vintage outdoor supply mail-order page, complete with numbered gear listings, Japanese labels, and an order-by-phone line. Printed with water-based inks in Fort Collins, Colorado, on a 10L cotton canvas tote with a spacious main compartment and reinforced straps for over-the-shoulder carry. Built for daily hauls, market runs, and weekend getaways.

headline: Topo Designs x Pine Printshop Ceramic Mug
body: Pine Printshop owner Garrett Danielson’s Masu graphic, inspired by mid-century advertising and folk art, sits on a 14 oz. black ceramic mug. Built for the first pour of the morning, at camp or at home.

headline: Town Socks
body: Perfect for hiking, the Town Sock features a lightweight wool blend with the right amount of structure and cushion.

headline: Topo Designs x Pine Printshop Catalog Tee
body: Designed by Garrett Danielson of Pine Printshop, the Catalog Tee pairs bold, heritage-inspired graphics into a throwback catalog layout. Everything you need for an adventure on your back. Gear up and get out.
